definitions.explanation: Being aware of one's own condition, situation, or responsibilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自覚|じかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: To have a sense of responsibility.

examples.japanese: {自覚|じかく}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{自覚|じかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To be aware of one's position.

notes:
{自覚|じかく} means being conscious of one's own condition, situation, or responsibilities. Used as both a noun and a suru verb.

FORMS:
{自|じ} (self) + {覚|かく} (awareness, perception)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {自覚|じかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be aware/conscious of
- {自覚|じかく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become aware, to realize
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自覚|じかく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have awareness of ~
- {自覚|じかく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: to lack self-awareness

MEDICAL USAGE:
{自覚|じかく}⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (subjective symptoms) refers to symptoms the patient can feel, as opposed to ⟦{他覚|たかく}→他覚：noentry⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧ (objective symptoms found through examination).

USAGE:
Often used when discussing responsibility or maturity: ⟦{社会人|しゃかいじん}→社会人：13730_shakaijin⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自覚|じかく} (awareness of being a working adult). Carries a nuance of moral or personal accountability.
